suites.name: persistent-text-catalog
suites.description: Repeated selection, text projection, immutable outputs and mutable records across a long sequence.

cells.code: nodeRepl.write(records.length)

selection = await textTools.select('group-0')
selections.push(selection.map(record => record.id))
nodeRepl.write(selection.map(record => record.id).join('|'))

var selectionText = await textTools.lines(selection)
nodeRepl.write(selectionText)
